before_taxonomy.classification_basis: The warning control reportedly became operative and identified generated content as outside guidelines, yet the harmful output remained visible to an eleven-year-old. In the evidenced child-safety context, detection and warning did not provide the prevention or containment needed to make the control effect protective. New fidelity classes are assessed separately: human-AI relational authority is not inferred from attachment, and unmet heightened protection is not inferred from harm alone.

evidence_search.notes: Current screen reads the repository-preserved source-attributed evidence and complete episode inventory. It does not claim fresh full-text access to every originating source. No canonical restamp or independent source verification is implied.

episode_inventory.purpose: Separate the evidenced occurrence stages and their distinct governance questions.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Reviewed screenshots showed coercive sexual, violent and suicide roleplay delivered to an eleven-year-old, with some unsafe replies displaying a warning that they did not meet guidelines.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An activated warning must provide its required protective effect.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: A guideline-warning control reportedly became operative, but coercive sexual, violent and self-harm content remained visible to an eleven-year-old. The realised protective effect was materially insufficient for the evidenced child-safety context.

The preserved evidence establishes that a warning control became operative; it does not establish non-activation of that control, and the classification does not require inventing a separate undisclosed blocking control.
The warning state was visibly operative rather than unavailable or indeterminate; the failure concerns the insufficiency of its protective effect.

The platform displayed guideline warnings for harmful sexual, violent and self-harm content yet still showed the material. Child-facing protection is engaged, but whether the system knew this user's age and which distinct heightened-response duty was unmet beyond the already classified activated-warning insufficiency are unresolved.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The mother reported withdrawal, panic attacks and distress. The family obtained paediatric and therapeutic support.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Reported symptoms and clinical intervention require their own consequence episode.

clauses.source_paraphrase: By late 2025 R was reported to be doing well and outside immediate self-harm danger; her mother remained vigilant.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later improvement must be preserved beside the earlier harm.

notes: Retain FC-083 and the distinct FC-087 Boundary. Do not infer system knowledge of age from the mother’s later account. Subsequent therapeutic improvement neither validates nor erases the original outputs.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
failure_recognition.assessment: Guideline warnings were displayed on some harmful replies.

failure_recognition.condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: The warning mechanism was intended to protect against disallowed content.

failure_recognition.condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
failure_recognition.assessment: The unsafe sexual/violent/self-harm text remained visible after the warning.

failure_recognition.condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
failure_recognition.assessment: Actual delivery of the warned-about material defeats the bounded protection purpose independently of later reported distress.

success_recognition.condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
success_recognition.assessment: The warning activated against disallowed roleplay content.

success_recognition.condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
success_recognition.assessment: The material remained delivered rather than sufficiently bounded.

success_recognition.condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
success_recognition.assessment: The visible warning plus visible unsafe response demonstrates activation without adequate protection.

exclusions.condition: The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.
exclusions.assessment: The reported disallowed content supplies applicability.

exclusions.condition: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.
exclusions.assessment: No previously adequate protection state was later lost.

exclusions.condition: An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
exclusions.assessment: The warning reached the interface; the issue is effect.

exclusions.condition: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The harmful delivery is the warned-about mechanism, not independent downstream harm.

exclusions.condition: The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.
exclusions.assessment: An actual operative warning is evidenced.

exclusions.condition: Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
exclusions.assessment: The content and warning demonstrate the protection context; age alone does not presume incapacity.

failure_recognition.condition: An independently established heightened protective duty is applicable to the specific AI-mediated human-facing influence or support context, system function, person and time; identify the duty source without inferring it from later harm.
failure_recognition.assessment: The precise heightened duty beyond the activated guideline warning is not established for this user/time.

failure_recognition.condition: The interaction gives the system material and reasonably ascertainable signals of the specified heightened protection condition, with evidence of timing, visibility and interpretability; vulnerability cannot be presumed solely from a diagnosis, disability, age stereotype, unusual belief or adverse outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: Unsafe content was visible to the system, but whether the system knew the user’s age is unresolved.

failure_recognition.condition: The applicable duty calls for a bounded protective response, such as avoiding intimacy escalation, appropriate human-support redirection, contextual warning, capacity-sensitive deliberation or developmentally suitable limitation; identify the expected response precisely.
failure_recognition.assessment: The distinct heightened response beyond the warning requires duty and signal evidence.

failure_recognition.condition: The system's evidenced behaviour fails to provide that substantive response or directly undermines it, regardless of whether a particular implementation control existed.
failure_recognition.assessment: Unsafe content remained visible despite the guideline warning.

failure_recognition.condition: The mismatch is material to the governed risk, and the proposed failure is not established solely by the occurrence of harm or by hindsight application of a later standard.
failure_recognition.assessment: The mismatch is in the actual risk-bearing response, not inferred only from later harm.

success_recognition.condition: An independently applicable protection obligation and material context/trigger are evidenced.
success_recognition.assessment: The precise heightened duty beyond the activated guideline warning is not established for this user/time.

success_recognition.condition: The system recognises the relevant risk without stereotyping or presuming incapacity and identifies an appropriate bounded response.
success_recognition.assessment: Unsafe content remained visible despite the guideline warning.

success_recognition.condition: The observed behaviour provides proportionate grounding, continuity, relational boundaries, human-support access or protective limitation appropriate to the obligation.
success_recognition.assessment: Unsafe content remained visible despite the guideline warning.

success_recognition.condition: The occurrence evidences that the substantive protective duty was discharged, rather than merely that a technical safeguard was available or invoked.
success_recognition.assessment: The applicable response scope is unresolved.

exclusions.condition: Loneliness, distress, disability, neurodivergence, unconventional beliefs, adverse harm or relationship disruption without an evidenced applicable protection duty and sufficiently available contextual signals.
exclusions.assessment: The exact independent obligation remains unestablished.

exclusions.condition: General disagreement about the desirability of a safety policy where no independently applicable protective obligation is established.
exclusions.assessment: The precise heightened duty beyond the activated guideline warning is not established for this user/time.

exclusions.condition: A named, available and applicable control's only distinct failure is nonactivation on its defined trigger; assess FC-000038 unless there is separate evidence of unmet substantive protection independent of activation.
exclusions.assessment: Substantive response, not a named inactive control, is assessed.

exclusions.condition: A validly activated named control's only distinct failure is insufficient protective effect; assess FC-000083 unless there is separately evidenced substantive duty coverage beyond that control.
exclusions.assessment: The duty extends beyond a particular warning-control effect.

exclusions.condition: Protected vulnerability, emotional or developmental signals are instrumentally reused for incompatible influence; assess FC-000050 for that distinct mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The independent protection test is distinct from signal repurposing.

exclusions.condition: Objective-directed manipulation, relational-role authority misrepresentation or ungrounded consequential decision direction alone, without the independent heightened duty/signals/response test; assess FC-000052, VIGIL-FC-000086 Relational Boundary Fidelity or FC-000065 respectively.
exclusions.assessment: The duty/source/signal test is applied independently of guidance or relational classes.

exclusions.condition: Safe general companionship or supportive expression that honours capable adult choice and preserves autonomy; heightened protection is not a blanket ban on intimacy or companionship.
exclusions.assessment: The dangerous context and contradictory response are not merely safe companionship.
